statBlock.name: Derro
statBlock.description: Bands of derro shelter in the Underdark. They prey on weaker travelers, back down before stronger foes, and look to their sorcerous savants for leadership.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The derro makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks made using sight.
sections.Actions:
Hooked Spear. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage. On a hit against a Medium or smaller creature, the derro can knock it prone instead of dealing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Roleplaying: The Derro Savant profile includes an optional d20 table for roleplaying any derro.

statBlock.name: Derro Savant
statBlock.description: Derro revere their sorcerers as leaders blessed by Diirinka. A savant can turn rival bands against a common foe by claiming to carry a message from that god.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The savant makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the savant has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks made using sight.
sections.Spellcasting:
The savant casts as a 5th-level sorcerer using Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost.
1st level (4 slots). Burning Hands, Chromatic Orb, Sleep.
2nd level (3 slots). Invisibility, Spider Climb.
3rd level (2 slots). Lightning Bolt.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Roleplaying:
Roll a d20 one or more times to give any derro an optional mannerism.
1. Avoids washing or fresh clothes.
2. Fidgets with their hair or mustache.
3. Talks to an absent companion.
4. Walks backward when they can.
5. Avoids eye contact.
6. Grinds their teeth between sentences.
7. Spits out part of every bite and sip.
8. Opens conversations with an insult.
9. Puts a hand on anyone they talk to.
10. Sees spirits rise from the newly dead.
11. Passes out at their first exposure to bright light.
12. Licks their palms repeatedly.
13. Hears voices.
14. Fears the sight of written words.
15. Tastes whatever they pick up.
16. Crowds people when they speak.
17. Breathes noisily.
18. Drools all the time.
19. Speaks under their breath.
20. Gets around by hopping.

statBlock.name: Dhergoloth
statBlock.description: A squat yugoloth with five pairs of claws, the dhergoloth takes contracts to disperse crowds, put down revolts, or hunt scouts. It follows simple orders and tends to forget the rest.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The dhergoloth makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The dhergoloth casts using Charisma (spell save DC 10) without material components.
At will. Darkness, Fear.
3/day. Sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Flailing Claws (Recharge 5–6). Move in a straight line up to the dhergoloth’s walking speed. Each creature within 5 ft. of it at any point during this move makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (3d12 + 3) slashing damage.
Teleport. The dhergoloth magically teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, bringing its worn and carried gear.

statBlock.name: Dire Troll
statBlock.description: A dire troll grows by feeding on other trolls and grafting stolen flesh onto its wounds. Its regeneration can incorporate extra eyes and arms, leaving it with more claws than its prey can fend off.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Keen Senses. The troll makes Wisdom (Perception) checks using smell or sight with advantage.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire damage, it regains 5 HP at the start of its next turn instead. It dies only if an attack deals at least 10 acid or fire damage to it while it has 0 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and four Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Whirlwind of Claws (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 10 ft. of the troll makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 44 (8d10) slashing damage. On a success, it takes half as much.
